title: Batteries
notes: Battery passport mandatory for EV, LMT and industrial batteries >2 kWh from 2027-02-18 (Art. 77(1)). Reg. (EU) 2025/1561 moved the Art. 48(1) due-diligence trigger to 2027-08-18 and the Art. 48(5) Commission guidelines deadline to 2026-07-26. Major obligations remain future-dated: Art. 8(1) recycled-content declaration from 2028-08-18, Art. 8(2) minimum shares from 2031-08-18, Art. 10(2) minimum performance values from 2027-08-18.
